data.title: Three Chinese women rescued from alleged detainment by compatriots in Chon Buri
data.description: CHON BURI - Three Chinese women were rescued in the early hours of Wednesday after police were alerted that four men of their same nationality allegedly detained them for sexual abuse and extortion at a house in Bang Lamung district.

data.title: Bhumjaithai calls to speed up charter rewrite
data.description: Bhumjaithai Party (BJT) MP Nikorn Chamnong has urged opposition parties to quickly submit their proposed constitutional amendments to parliament, warning that the process of drafting a new charter could take so long that it may not be completed before the next general election.

data.title: Dam in northeastern Thailand faces threat from invasive fish
data.description: Fisheries officials are stepping up their surveillance of invasive blackchin tilapia at Lam Pao Dam in Kalasin after finding 111 fish over the past three weeks, including 12 egg-bearing females.

data.title: Cheating in state exams to become criminal offence
data.description: The government is fast-tracking legislation to make cheating in public-sector recruitment exams a criminal offence and blacklist offenders from working for any state agency.

data.title: Thailand outlines UN peace goals
data.description: Thailand will focus on peace, human rights and regional cooperation at the 81st UN General Assembly (UNGA81) while closely monitoring Cambodian-related issues, Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow said yesterday.

data.title: Nan gets nod for new university
data.description: The cabinet yesterday approved a bill to establish Nan University, turning the Nan campus of Rajamangala University of Technology Lanna into an autonomous public university focused on innovation and the province's needs.

data.title: Cabinet endorses strategic plan to combat fuel crisis
data.description: The cabinet yesterday endorsed a strategic plan for the Oil Fuel Fund and a fuel crisis response plan covering 2026-2029 with wider use of biofuels made from domestic raw materials to help cope with volatility in global energy markets.

data.title: US human rights lawyer and former White House counsel back Yim Leak
data.description: International human rights lawyer Jared Genser and Lanny J Davis, a former White House special counsel and adviser to former US presidents Bill Clinton and George W Bush, have joined the legal and advocacy team supporting Cambodian businessman Yim Leak, according to Seiden Law LLP, which serves as Mr Yim's chief global counsel.

data.title: SLF to recoup defaulted loans more aggressively
data.description: The government has urged the Student Loan Fund (SLF) to step up debt collection from 2.6 million borrowers in default, distinguishing between those unable and unwilling to repay.

data.title: Heavy rain raises downstream flood risk
data.description: Heavy to very heavy rain forecast across much of the country over the next five days is expected to increase flood risks in Bangkok and the central plains, with water levels in parts of Ayutthaya and Ang Thong potentially rising by up to 1.25 metres.

data.title: Dates set for Queen Mother's cremation
data.description: An official schedule for the royal cremation ceremony of Her Majesty Queen Sirikit The Queen Mother was issued on Tuesday by the Government Public Relations Department (PRD).

data.title: Minister backs DSI boss appointment
data.description: Justice Minister Rutthapon Naowarat has dismissed claims that the appointment of Pol Capt Piya Raksakul as the new director-general of the Department of Special Investigation (DSI) was a reward for his role in the Senate election collusion case.

data.title: Klatham disputes whip exit
data.description: Reports that the Klatham Party would leave the opposition whip and possibly join the Bhumjaithai-led government have created uncertainty over the parliamentary landscape.

data.title: Serial killer Aem Cyanide gets fifth death sentence
data.description: The Criminal Court on Tuesday sentenced Sararat Rangsiwuthaporn, aka Aem Cyanide, 39, to death for fatally poisoning her creditor in Phetchaburi province in August 2022.

data.title: Hospital chief in hot water over card game
data.description: Health minister orders investigation after video surfaces of ‘gambling’ in outpatient department

data.title: City Hall pledges quick reopening of two children's museums in Bangkok
data.description: The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) has promised to quickly find a new team to operate and reopen two childen's museums being forced to close next week by financial red tape.

data.title: Fishing boat sinks off Chon Buri, 3 dead, 4 missing
data.description: A fishing boat carrying 22 crew members has sunk off the coast of Chon Buri, with three people confirmed dead, four missing and 15 rescued, marine authorities said.

data.title: Chakriwat seeks return to Thailand for life-saving surgery
data.description: Chakriwat Vivacharawongse, an estranged son of His Majesty the King, has appealed for help to return to Thailand from Malaysia for medical treatment, saying his health has deteriorated significantly.
